name: r59_deploy_ci
title: Tiny deploy CI (gate + md5 kit build)
intro: R59 (2026-10-15): the critique's 'tiny CI' -- every push/PR runs the drift gate + the FULL test gate on a clean checkout, and the latest kit manifest is rebuilt + md5-verified so the uploadable kit is reproducible from a clean clone. Also ships tools/build_kit.py (the generic manifest-driven kit builder, R36+ installer convention) and tools/kits/ manifests (R58's kit becomes rebuildable from the tree alone). CI never commits/pushes back; deploy commits stay a human smoke-tested step.
markers: CI runs the full gate with the safe discovery mode
CI runs the docs drift gate
CI rebuilds + md5-verifies the latest kit
CI has read-only repo permissions (never writes back)
builder verifies the GENERATED bytes (r11 lesson)
backup contract: an existing *.pre_rNN.bak is never clobbered
the R58 kit is rebuildable from a clean clone
the bare-discover trap is a permanent pin
regenerated manual keeps its generated appendix
commit_message: R59: tiny deploy CI (gate + md5 kit build) + manifest-driven kit builder
